_comment_elevation_reversals: DEM under-sample fixes found via `npm run check:elevation` and confirmed on the topo map via the map debug tool's flow arrows. IDs are from the current `npm run data` build; `data:refresh` renumbers nodes and breaks these. Each pair was a piste reversed because our SRTM sample read one endpoint too low; corrected to the Terrarium DEM values (which matched the topo reads). Several were near-flat mis-samples that showed spurious both-way arrows and become clean one-way descents once corrected. n34 is a special case: it sits at a hut/restaurant entrance that is artificially flattened for pedestrian access, so it is set ~level with n276 (2073, within flat tolerance) to KEEP the n276<->n34 traverse bidirectional, deliberately overriding the DEM (which reads ~2083).
